rooms.name: Orientation Room
rooms.description: A bright meeting room with a welcome banner and your rotation schedule pinned to a corkboard
rooms.unlock_text: Welcome to the Ministry! Your one-month rotation starts today.

rooms.name: Work Pass Processing Unit
rooms.description: Rows of workstations with dual monitors, stacks of application folders, and a wall of policy binders
rooms.unlock_text: Week 1: You report to the Work Pass Processing Unit. Time to handle real cases.

rooms.name: Dispute Resolution Centre
rooms.description: A calm mediation room with a round table, case files neatly stacked, and a whiteboard of active cases
rooms.unlock_text: Week 2: The Dispute Resolution Centre. Things get more nuanced here.

rooms.name: Workplace Safety Desk
rooms.description: An open-plan area with incident dashboards on wall screens and a 'Days Since Last Papercut: 3' sign
rooms.unlock_text: Week 3: Workplace Safety. The team takes compliance very seriously (and papercuts personally).

rooms.name: Director's Office
rooms.description: A corner office with a view, a standing desk, and exactly one framed motivational poster: 'Data-Driven Empathy'
rooms.unlock_text: Week 4: The Director wants your rotation report. Last stop.
